ISRIC SoilGrids 2.0.file_identification: The 0-5 cm exports were saved unnamed as out.tif ... out (4).tif. Each was matched to the named 5-15 cm file it correlates with pixel by pixel (Spearman 0.95-0.99): out=bdod, out (1)=clay, out (2)=cfvo (coarse fragments), out (3)=sand, out (4)=organic carbon. There is no 0-5 cm silt file. The first build (2026-10-10) had identified these by value range and wrongly read out (2) as organic carbon, out (3) as silt and out (4) as sand; fixed 2026-10-12. Organic carbon is treated as organic carbon density (ocd, hg/m3) as Rajat described the download; if it was soil organic carbon content (soc, dg/kg) the column is g/kg instead of kg/m3.
